name: MBTI Bot Hub
tagline: Front desk for a team of MBTI-personality bots
description: Works as the single front desk for a team of bots built around MBTI personalities. You bring it a request and it relays the work to whichever typed persona fits, standing in for you so you never juggle the team directly. It surfaced through a Tokyo hackathon circle as the hub of that bot set.
author: nishiyama_dev
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
